paragraphs: Rabbana Nehemiah, brother of the Exilarch.
See the entry Rabbana Nehemiah, Rav’s grandson.[^1]

notes.text: בר בריה דרב means son of Rav’s son, a paternal grandson, not son of Rav’s grandson. Rabbana is full in both occurrences. ריש גלותא is the office Exilarch; the heading specifies his brother.
